answer:
**Answer**

According to J.D. Power’s 2014 “Explore All … SUVs” pages, **both Ford and Jeep released the largest number of distinct SUV models for that year – six each**.

| Manufacturer | 2014 SUV models listed by J.D. Power | # of models |
|--------------|-------------------------------------|-------------|
| **Ford** | Edge, Escape, Expedition, Expedition EL, Explorer, Flex | 6 |
| **Jeep** | Cherokee, Compass, Grand Cherokee, Patriot, Wrangler, Wrangler Unlimited | 6 |
| GMC | Acadia, Terrain, Yukon, Yukon XL | 4 |
| Chevrolet | Captiva Sport, Equinox, Suburban, Tahoe, Traverse | 5 |
| Cadillac | Escalade, Escalade ESV, SRX | 3 |
| Nissan | Armada, Murano, Rogue | 3 |
| Lincoln | MKX | 1 |
| Honda | CR‑V | 1 |
| Toyota | 4Runner, FJ Cruiser, Highlander, RAV4 | 4 |
| Volkswagen | Tiguan (plus Touareg in 2015, not 2014) | 1 |

**Sources**

* **Ford 2014 SUV list** – displays the six models above (Edge, Escape, Expedition, Expedition EL, Explorer, Flex)【1†source】.  
* **Jeep 2014 SUV list** – displays the six models shown (Cherokee, Compass, Grand Cherokee, Patriot, Wrangler, Wrangler Unlimited)【2†source】.

The other manufacturers’ listings, as seen on their respective J.D. Power “Explore All 2014 … SUVs” pages, contain fewer models, confirming the tie between Ford and Jeep for the most SUV releases in 2014.
